idea: A training-focus picker in Profile (preset or 3-slider: Powerlifting / Bodybuilding / Conditioning) that writes training_phase and/or goal_priorities directly.
moment: Tried to find any way to tell the engine 'shift toward hypertrophy now' and found none anywhere in the app.
howOften: Likely every phase change, i.e. every few months, but currently impossible at any frequency.

idea: Keep the set-entry confirm button in the same screen position (right column) for RIR as for weight/reps, instead of moving to a full-width bottom button.
moment: Advancing from the reps keypad to the RIR pill screen mid-flow.
howOften: Every logged set with RIR shown, i.e. most sets on most sessions.

idea: Let a logged set be edited for a few seconds after a RIR-pill tap commits it, instead of instant-commit-and-close.
moment: Realized a mis-tapped RIR pill (adjacent pill, sweaty/shaky post-set) has no visible undo path from the sheet itself.
howOften: Rare per session, but costly when it happens given the already-confirmed 'no undo on set delete' finding from the prior overnight run.

idea: Surface the paused/resumable second program (e.g. 'Strength + BUD/S Conditioning') with a clearer signal of what happens to the currently active program if you hit Resume on it.
moment: Opened a paused program's detail page and found a full 'Resume' CTA sitting right next to an unrelated active program, with no visible explanation of what resuming does to the other one.
howOften: Whenever more than one program exists, which this account already has.

idea: A lightweight way to compute (or fake, for test purposes) athlete_state for a non-primary account, so future audits/clones aren't permanently stuck on 'No analysis yet' for the State/Insights tabs.
moment: Every athlete_state-dependent screen on the fresh clone read empty, even with 129 real cloned workouts underneath it.
howOften: Every future audit pass that wants to visually verify anything downstream of the daily engine run.
